title: consolidate-subscribe-api-and-credential-provider-across-py-ts-go
author: Asha Patel
commits: a2c3f8e: feat(cred): add CredentialProvider interface and basic implementations
b4d5e6f: feat(ts/subscribe): add subscribe async generator + tests
c7d8e90: feat(py/subscribe): add async iterator and contextmanager facade
d9e0f12: feat(go/subscribe): channel-based subscriber and Close semantics
e1f2a34: perf(subscribe): wire retry profiles and preflight checks
f3a4b56: docs: rewrite streaming.md and add multi-lang examples
g5b6c78: fix(deps): bump minor versions and update changelogs
discussion: Liam O'Connor (reviewer): Overall looks good, I have two questions: 1) can we keep the previous transport-level preflight check for auth to avoid an extra roundtrip in the common case? 2) how does this interact with dedicated/delegated auth tokens?

Asha Patel (author): For (1) we kept a transport preflight path in the default provider — it short-circuits when cached_token.valid() is true, so no extra roundtrip. For (2) the CredentialProvider supports a lease_ttl_hint so callers (Dedicated/Enterprise) can plug in leased tokens; added notes in docs and tests that simulate short TTLs.

Priya Nair (reviewer): Please add a small test that simulates token rotation mid-stream and assert no duplicate messages nor silent stream terminations. Also add a TS typing note for the async generator return type.
Asha Patel (author): Added integration test test_subscribe_token_rotation in both TS and Py; TS typing updated to AsyncIterable<Message | ControlEvent>.

Ethan Brooks (reviewer): Minor nit: rename subscribe.close() -> close() on the subscriber for consistency with Go's Close() pattern? We should standardize names rather than having language-specific variants.
Asha Patel (author): Renamed the Python/TS convenience helper `subscriber.close()` to `close()` and added adapter notes. Kept Go's `Close()` idiomatic casing but documented the mapping.
ci_checks: ci/unit-tests: passed (ts: 128 tests, py: 312 tests, go: 84 tests)
ci/integration-long: flaky on first run (timeout), reran and passed
release_notes: Cross-SDK: introduce `subscribe()` facade (deprecates `stream()`), add CredentialProvider abstraction to decouple token lifecycle from transport, introduce streaming retry presets, bump versions: Python 1.31.0, TypeScript 1.27.0, Go 1.8.1. Backwards-compatible shim included; migration guide in docs/streaming.md.
notes_for_release_manager: Publish TS/Py/Go packages within same 2-hour window to avoid cross-version docs confusion. Highlight deprecation in SDK release notes and docs. Monitor long-running subscription canary for token rotation regressions.
